notes.title: 11-17-23 Update: Changed Last 2 Achievement Triggers
notes.notes: Updated the Mission Complete and Tutorial achievement triggers.

notes.title: Update Note 11-17-23: Changed Achievement Triggers
notes.notes: The achievement triggers have been changed because there is a difference between how certain gaming mechanics manifest between different platforms (i.e. Epic versus Steam) and how they are coded (i.e. an overlap event trigger versus manually triggering an event).

notes.title: Minor Changes and Updates
notes.notes: There were some changes made to some of the widgets and skill tree enhancements. You may have to uninstall and reinstall the game for the changes to take effect, however, you should have a more enjoyable experience.
